newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads two for rape and a drug smuggler.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads two for rape and a drug smuggler.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded two men for rape and a third for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, the Saudi interior ministry said.

A ministry statement carried on state-run television said two men were executed in Medina after being found guilty of breaking into a Saudi man's home, raping his wife and stealing. It did not give their nationalities.
Earlier the ministry said a Bahraini man was beheaded in the eastern city of Dammam for smuggling heroin into the country.
The executions raised to 31 the number of people put to death in Saudi Arabia this year.
The conservative kingdom enforces sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
